O.content: The title inscription reads "Risk Index of Hazard H in US States".
The region labeled "ID" is filled pale yellow.
The region labeled "SC" is filled dark burgundy.
The Arizona-shaped map region is filled gray and has no visible "AZ" inscription.
The vertical scale has pale yellow at its top beside the inscriptions "High" and "100", and dark burgundy at its bottom beside "Low" and "0".

B.text: If the map’s state fills are encoded by the adjacent color scale, the pale-yellow end labeled "High" and "100" represents higher Risk Index values than the dark burgundy end labeled "Low" and "0". For this routing task, select the offered state with the highest displayed risk; gray is not assigned a position on the shown color scale.
B.conditions: Applies if each labeled state region uses the displayed Risk Index scale and gray denotes no displayed scale value.
